results.title: Shark Frenzy
results.overview: A family vacation goes wrong when their daughter and her friends get lost at sea on a fishing boat. When that boat is destroyed, they survive in a row boat, then the open ocean. Her parents race to find her as sharks circle ever closer in a deadly fight for survival.

results.title: Chronicles of the Inconvenient Truth
results.overview: In 1986 the Chernobyl disaster happened. This documentary tells the story of how the Bulgarian government hid the disaster consequences from the people, while ordering radiation-free food and water from abroad for the highest echelon of the Central Committee.

results.title: The Cinema of Francis Lai
results.original_title: Le cinéma de Francis Lai - Avec Lambert Wilson, Anne Sila et Gabriel Yared
results.overview: Radio France, with the support of Lambert Wilson, Anne Sila and Gabriel Yared, pays tribute to the great film composer Francis Lai with a journey through his work, from A Man and a Woman to Black Eyes.

results.title: The Sandbox
results.overview: In Singapore, a stuntman teams up with his brother and ex-sister-in-law to keep their declining stunt school alive. Just as their dream seems about to fade, a rumour that Marvel Studios is scouting locally brings a surge of wannabe superheroes and misfits to their doorstep, convinced they’ll be whipped into crime-fighting shape.

results.title: WWE SummerSlam 2026: Saturday
results.overview: The 2026 SummerSlam, also promoted as SummerSlam: Minnesota, is a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It is the 39th annual SummerSlam and took place as a two-night event on August 1st and 2nd at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, Minnesota.

results.title: The Trial That Never Happened
results.overview: Ana Clara Gomes Machado was five years old and used to say she wanted to be just like her mother when she grew up. On the morning of February 2, 2021, while playing outside her home, she was struck by four rifle rounds fired by a military police officer in Rio de Janeiro.  The Civil Police detective who arrived at the scene of the killing stated there was no doubt as to who fired the shots: Corporal Bruno Delaroli. The case remained without a trial for five years. Just as the family believed justice was within reach, a new lawyer joined the case, and to this day, the officer has yet to stand trial. That lawyer was, at the time, a sitting senator—now a candidate for the Presidency of the Republic—Flávio Bolsonaro.  What was a senator’s motive for defending a man caught in the act of murdering a child? To this day, her mother, Cristiane Gomes da Silva, mourns the loss of her daughter and the justice that never arrived.

results.title: 70 Jahre ESC - More than Music
results.overview: In 2026, the Eurovision Song Contest celebrates its 70th anniversary. With around 160 million viewers, the ESC is one of the world's biggest music spectacles. This documentary looks back on seven decades filled with music, emotions and passion. From its beginnings as a chanson competition in 1956 through flamboyant outfits and spectacular performances to unforgettable victories, bitter defeats and the political debates of the recent past. Stars like Jean Paul Gaultier, Hape Kerkeling, Tom Neuwirth (aka Conchita Wurst), and Germany's first ESC winner, Nicole, share their experiences on and off stage. The documentary paints a multifaceted portrait of the ESC, highlighting its profound influence on music, fashion, and society, as well as on the LGBTQIA+ community, thus becoming a vibrant journey through seven decades of European pop culture history.

results.title: Being Ben
results.overview: With his NBA career getting a restart this season with the Sacramento Kings, former No. 1 draft pick Ben Simmons opens up in a new ESPN E60 documentary about the highs and lows of his extraordinary career, his attempt to reclaim his place in the game – and his lifelong passion for fishing.

results.title: The Tunnel
results.overview: Suffering from post-traumatic stress after a violent assault in a tunnel, Janet Crane returns to the subterranean passageway to confront her fears and regain her freedom. When a hooded figure starts following her, the past and present collide as Janet tries to escape.

results.title: RN 72, à la conquête de l'Ouest
results.original_title: RN 72, à la conquête de l'Ouest
results.overview: As the 2027 presidential election approaches, this documentary follows the National Rally's year-long effort to establish itself in western France. Led by close allies of Marine Le Pen, the strategy culminates in several municipal victories in 2026, including the party's historic first win in the western town of La Flèche.

results.title: Being Towards Death
results.overview: After a failed suicide attempt, Zhang Xiaobing (Jiang Long) is sent to Ward 10 — a ward for the critically ill, but strangely full of joy. Among patients clinging to life, a man who wanted to die discovers the courage to live.

results.title: My Own Last Supper
results.original_title: Rencana Besar untuk Mati dengan Tenang
results.overview: 76-year-old widower Encek convenes his children for a final dinner, unveiling concealed memoirs of love, loss and generational wounds before choosing the sea as his reunion place with his deceased wife.

results.title: Riverkeeper
results.overview: Veteran riverkeeper, Dr. Jackie Echols, protects the environment and majority Black communities throughout the South River watershed in metro Atlanta. When the city begins construction on the largest police training facility in America (Cop City), she joins the growing resistance movement, revealing the hidden connection between corporate development, unchecked pollution, and environmental racism persistent throughout the region.

results.title: Jimpa
results.overview: Hannah and her non-binary teenager Frances visit her gay grandfather Jimpa in Amsterdam. Frances expresses a desire to stay with their grandfather for a year, challenging Hannah's parenting beliefs and forcing her to confront past issues.

results.title: Anti-Princesas
results.overview: At the Neza-Bordo prison, ten incarcerated women take part in a theater workshop led by La Cana. Through rehearsals, the stage becomes a space to name violence, revisit their own stories and recover a voice that was silenced for years.  Anti-Princesas follows this process up to the final performance in front of their families, interweaving the theater work with the participants' testimonies. Their accounts reveal stories marked by gender-based violence, abusive relationships, long periods without a sentence, and a justice system that often fails to effectively apply the gender perspective set out in Mexican law.  More than a film about prison, Anti-Princesas is a collective portrait of ten women who, from confinement, find in theater a form of resistance, expression and freedom.

results.title: Space: 1999 4K Double Bill - Breakaway and The Metamorph
results.original_title: Space: 1999 4K Double Bill - Breakaway and The Metamorph
results.overview: This Breakaway day, Anderson Entertainment presents a spectacular cinematic event for UK fans of classic science fiction. This Space: 1999 double bill brings together the groundbreaking first episode, Breakaway, and the acclaimed second-season opener, Metamorph, playing in a cinema near you. Featuring groundbreaking visual effects, profound questions, a stellar cast and action! All in the unmistakable style of Gerry and Sylvia Anderson, these two landmark episodes mark the beginning of the journey and the beginning of a new era of science fiction.

results.title: Procession
results.overview: June, a survivor of the Japanese American incarceration camps, takes her first pilgrimage for her 70th birthday, to confront all her demons, shame, and fear.

results.title: Ketticè
results.overview: Palermo, 2012. Giulio, a listless and dissatisfied 16-year-old, drifts through his days with no enthusiasm for school and no prospects for the future. His encounter with Ketty, a more self-assured peer, offers him an escape from the monotony.

results.title: It's Not Tomorrow Yet
results.overview: After her divorce, Lola tries to rebuild her life amidst raising her children and dealing with the pressures of those around her. An unexpected encounter leads her to explore long-held desires and understand that letting go can also be a way to start over again.

results.title: Ser Hamlet
results.overview: Eight actors with Down syndrome prepare to present Hamlet in an emblematic theater in Lima. In the intimacy of the rehearsal room, they gradually become their characters while confronting their own lives with the essential ideas of Shakespeare’s work.
